title: 무역보험법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Rule No. 1, Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (11) Omitted.

(12) The Enforcement Rules of the Trade Insurance Act are partially amended as follows:

The term "Minister of Knowledge Economy" in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2 (1), Article 2 (2), the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 3, Article 4, and the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 5 is replaced with "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy", respectively.

(13) through (63) Omitted.
